title: Extraordinary
text: Our guide, besides being very punctual, demonstrated in-depth knowledge of the entire history of the area we visited, its handling made us feel confident and free to ask questions.
author: victorn947

title: Experience in Seville authentic and very special. Recommended 100%
text: Thank you Miriam for this lovely experience for Triana. It was a trip of friends to Seville and you made it even prettier. We enjoy the neighborhood of Triana, its curiosities and gastronomy. A super special and very dynamic route where we try new flavors and where we discover a totally different Triana, even being the third time in Seville for some of us.
author: roci-rp

title: Super experience
text: The route was great. A tour different from those offered. Mirian made it great, very pleasant and also intimate. It is a tour in which you connect with the soul of the Triana neighborhood. I have been to Seville several times and this time, I have visited new and secret places. Highly recommended. It is also interactive with additional information in QR form that completes the route of 10. Do not hesitate to book it!
author: viajequet

title: Highly recommended route.
text:
What I liked the most was that there were only 5 women on the tour and Miriam. Finding something so intimate is not easy and Miriam offers it. 
And not only that, but also a completely different vision of how to enjoy Seville, in this case the neighborhood of Triana. 
I loved the route, I loved everything it gave us and I loved its passion and dedication.
I will definitely repeat with some other route.
author: D2122PCmiriaml

title: Phenomenal
text:
We were a group of 5 friends, 2 of them are Sevillian and enjoyed the 5 as if none of us were from Seville. 
Miriam not only taught us Triana, but she made us part of her story and infected us with her love for what she does.
Thank you very much for your experience.
author: 41mirianl
